What's new in Tareekh 2.3

Check here: only the CAPTCHA, and the case is updated

Tareekh 2.3 lets you check a saved case's next date without opening the court's website: tap Check here, type the court's CAPTCHA shown in Tareekh, and the case is updated. Check all here does the evening's checks one after another. The pictures use made-up example cases.

Check here

  • Next to “Check on eCourts” on every case, and in the Notes tab
  • Only the court's CAPTCHA is shown
  • By CNR, else case number, else party name
  • District courts, High Courts and the Supreme Court

The case is updated

  • Next date, purpose, stage, hearings
  • New orders saved in the case's folder
  • Calendar entry moved
  • A one-line summary of what changed

Check all here

  • All of the evening's checks, one after another
  • Also from the 6:30 pm notification
  • Skip a case if its court site is down
  • A summary at the end
You still type every CAPTCHA: Tareekh does not bypass it. If the court's site is down, slow, or needs a choice Tareekh cannot make, it says so, and Show the court's page opens the court's page itself.

How to use it

  1. Open a case and tap Check here (or tap Check here on a case in the Notes tab).
  2. Type the CAPTCHA shown and tap Search.
  3. Read the summary: the case, its calendar entry and its orders are already updated.
  4. In the evening, tap Check all here (Notes tab or the 6:30 pm notification) and type each CAPTCHA as it comes.

Screen by screen

Check here, on every case

“Check on eCourts” stays as it was. “Check here” is new: it shows only the court's CAPTCHA inside Tareekh.

  1. 1
    Check on eCourts

    As before: opens the court's own page, filled in, for you to see and use.

  2. 2
    Check here (new)

    The court's page works out of sight; only its CAPTCHA is shown in Tareekh.

  3. 3
    What it does

    After you type the CAPTCHA, the case is updated from the court's record.

Check all here, every evening

The Notes tab lists the hearings whose next date should be checked. Check them one after another.

  1. 1
    Check all here

    Goes through every case in the list: as soon as one is updated, the next case's CAPTCHA appears.

  2. 2
    Check here

    Check just this case, inside Tareekh.

  3. 3
    eCourts

    Or open the court's own page, as before.

Only the CAPTCHA

Tareekh fills in the court's page by CNR (or case number) out of sight and shows you its CAPTCHA.

The case, updated

The case is updated from the court's record: next date, purpose, stage, hearings, and new orders saved in its folder.

All checked
